en: Colorized postcard view of a landscaped spa garden with curved flowerbeds and a central path leading to a large white statue on a pedestal. Two women in long dresses and wide-brimmed hats stand near the statue. Behind them is dense greenery and a pavilion-like building, with forested hills in the background. The caption at the bottom reads in German about Bad Elster and a Hygiea statue and walking hall in the spa park.
